items.title: Tom McIntosh — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: Oh, is that right? What position did you play?

I played guard, pulling guard. Anyways, I thoroughly enjoyed it and playing with the big boys. Then I was drafted and I was sent to Germany. I had basic training in Alabama. My father, when I was in Baltimore, I knew about Count Basie, Duke Ellington and all the major jazz guys, Fats Waller. They all played in a major theatre in Baltimore that was the talk of the town. But, every week someone would be killed in that area so my father would never let me go. So, next thing I know, I’m in the Army and the first job…
What year was this that you were in Germany?
